groups.title: Information backup
groups.description: Backup copies of information, software, and systems should be maintained and regularly tested in accordance with the agreed topic-specific policy on backup.
groups.purpose: To enable recovery from loss of data or systems.
groups.guidance: A topic-specific policy on backup should be established to address the organization's data retention and information security requirements.(...)
groups.other_information: For further information on storage security, including retention consideration, see ISO/IEC 27040.
means_of_verification: Review backup policy documentation for defined retention periods and scope
Inspect backup logs to confirm scheduled backups completed successfully
Verify evidence of periodic restore tests and their results
Confirm backup storage location complies with security requirements (e.g. encryption, offsite/segregated storage)
